detail.longDescription: 📊 87 monochrome IT and cloud icons, CI checks against overlapping nodes and clipped labels, optional motion with a reduced-motion fallback, and export to SVG, PNG or vector PDF. Runs inside Claude Code, # OpenAI Codex, # GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Cline, Windsurf and Pi. Install: npx skills add cathrynlavery/diagram-design 🌐 https:// github.com/cathrynlavery/diagr am-design
